original: אֵלִ֣/י אֵ֭לִ/י לָ/מָ֣ה עֲזַבְתָּ֑/נִי רָח֥וֹק מִֽ֝/ישׁוּעָתִ֗/י דִּבְרֵ֥י שַׁאֲגָתִֽ/י׃
translation: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Far from my salvation are the words of my roaring.
uncertainties: Second clause is difficult; 'far from my salvation' may be read as 'why are you far from my salvation'
differences_from_web: WEB reads 'far from helping me' for 'far from my salvation'
WEB supplies 'Why are you so' before 'far'
_web_text: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?

original: הַשְׁלֵ֤ךְ עַל־יְהוָ֨ה ׀ יְהָבְ/ךָ֮ וְ/ה֪וּא יְכַ֫לְכְּלֶ֥/ךָ לֹא־יִתֵּ֖ן לְ/עוֹלָ֥ם מ֗וֹט לַ/צַּדִּֽיק׃
translation: Cast your burden upon the LORD, and he will sustain you; he will never let the righteous be shaken.
_web_text: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

original: גּ֣וֹל עַל־יְהוָ֣ה דַּרְכֶּ֑/ךָ וּ/בְטַ֥ח עָ֝לָ֗י/ו וְ/ה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
translation: Roll your way upon the LORD, and trust in him, and he will act.
differences_from_web: WEB 'Commit your way' renders the idiom 'roll'
WEB adds 'he will do this'; Hebrew has just 'he will act'
_web_text: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

translation: The day I am afraid, I will trust in you.
differences_from_web: WEB 'When I am afraid' smooths the Hebrew 'on the day I fear'
_web_text: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

translation: The eyes of the LORD are toward the righteous, and his ears toward their cry for help.
differences_from_web: WEB 'listen' is added as a verb
_web_text: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

original: לׅׄוּלֵׅׄ֗אׅׄ הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי לִ/רְא֥וֹת בְּֽ/טוּב־יְהוָ֗ה בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּֽים׃
translation: If I had not believed that I would see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living...
literal_notes: לוּלֵא is marked with extraordinary points in the text
uncertainties: The apodosis is left unspoken (aposiopesis); English versions often supply 'I would have despaired'
differences_from_web: WEB renders 'I am still confident' rather than the broken-off conditional 'if I had not believed'
_web_text: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

original: הַבֵּ֤יט יָמִ֨ין ׀ וּ/רְאֵה֮ וְ/אֵֽין־לִ֪/י מַ֫כִּ֥יר אָבַ֣ד מָנ֣וֹס מִמֶּ֑/נִּי אֵ֖ין דּוֹרֵ֣שׁ לְ/נַפְשִֽׁ/י׃
translation: Look to the right and see: there is no one who knows me. Refuge has perished from me; no one seeks after my soul.
differences_from_web: WEB 'is concerned for me' for 'recognizes me'
_web_text: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.
